not_in_the_report: Per-shot xG. The shot maps on pages 14 and 22 size their marks by xG but print no values, so the shot map cannot be priced from this report.

A shot-by-shot cumulative xG series. Pages 14 and 22 plot xG progression as rendered step charts with only the full-time total labelled (1.42 and 0.86), so the xG race cannot be reconstructed without reading values off an image.
